name: Dan Meuser
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Flushing, Queens County, N.Y., February 10, 1964; graduated from Babylon High School, Babylon, N.Y. 1982; attended New York Maritime University (now SUNY Maritime College), Bronx, N.Y., 1982-1983; B.A., Cornell University, Ithaca, N.Y., 1986; entrepreneur; business executive; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Eleventh Congress in 2008; Pennsylvania state secretary of revenue, 2011-2015; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-present).
